props.gloss_en: a person may not stand in the private domain and drink in the public domain, nor stand in the public domain and drink in the private domain
but if he brought his head and most of his body into the place where he drinks, it is permitted
and so in the wine press -- the mishna's clause whose reference Abaye and Rava dispute
Abaye: [drinking between] a karmelit [and another domain] is the same -- forbidden
Rava: [drinking between] a karmelit [and another domain] is not forbidden
Rava's ground: it [the karmelit] is itself a decree -- shall we arise and decree a decree for a decree?
[candidate] the press is a private domain
[candidate] the press is a public domain
Abaye: rather, is it not [that the press is] a karmelit?
Rava (and Rav Sheshet): 'and so in the wine press' concerns tithes
R' Meir: one drinks at the press, whether [mixed] with hot or with cold, and is exempt [from tithing]
R' Elazar b. R' Tzadok obligates [him to tithe]
the Sages: [mixed] with hot, he is obligated
the Sages: [mixed] with cold, he is exempt
the Sages' reason: because he returns the remainder [to the press]
our mishna: the tailor may not go out with his needle close to dark, lest he forget and go out
the baraita: the tailor may not go out with his needle stuck in his garment
the baraita: the tailor may not go out with his needle stuck in his garment on Shabbat eve at dark
the stam: whose is this [baraita]? it is R' Yehuda's

R' Meir: the tailor with the needle in his garment, the carpenter with the chip at his ear, the comber, the weaver, the dyer, the money-changer -- may not go out; if one went out, he is exempt but it is forbidden
R' Yehuda: a craftsman [going out] in the way of his craft is liable
R' Yehuda: and anyone else is exempt
one baraita: the zav may not go out with his pouch; if he did, he is exempt but it is forbidden
another baraita: he may not go out, and if he did, he is liable to a chatat
Rav Yosef: this [exempting baraita] is R' Meir's
this [obligating baraita] is R' Yehuda's -- said by Rav Yosef (11b.9) and again by Abaye and Rava (12a.3)
Abaye: you heard R' Meir [exempt] only in a thing whose usual way this is not; where it is its usual way, did you hear it?
(entertained) R' Meir exempts even where it is the thing's usual way
(consequence) then a layman who carved a kav in a log on Shabbat -- would R' Meir also not hold him liable?
Rav Hamnuna: here [the liable baraita] is a zav who had two sightings
Rav Hamnuna: there [the exempt baraita] is a zav who had three sightings
R' Zeira: this tanna is the one who said that any [use for] preventing filth is not significant
the mishna: one who overturns a bowl on the wall -- if so that the bowl be rinsed, it is under 'if water be placed'
the mishna: if so that the wall not be damaged, it is not under 'if water be placed'
the seifa: a trough into which a drip fell -- the water that splashes and overflows is not under 'if water be placed'
the seifa: and the water inside it is under 'if water be placed'
Abaye and Rava: and that [exempting baraita] is R' Shimon's
a person may go out in tefillin on Shabbat eve at dark
Rabba bar Rav Huna: a person must touch his tefillin every hour
the reason for the permission: therefore he remembers them [and will not go out in them on Shabbat]
Chananya: a person must feel his garment on Shabbat eve at dark
Rav Yosef: [Chananya's is] a great halakha for Shabbat

answered_by.gloss_en: אלא אביי ורבא דאמרי תרוייהו: לא קשיא -- הא רבי יהודה, והא רבי שמעון (= p_zav_chayav_r_yehuda, p_zav_patur_r_shimon)

objections.gloss_en: אימור דשמעת ליה לרבי מאיר במידי דלאו היינו אורחיה, במידי דהיינו אורחיה מי שמעת ליה? -- the zav's pouch is carried in its usual way, where R' Meir was never heard to exempt
מאי שנא זב בעל שתי ראיות דחייב, דמיבעי ליה לבדיקה -- זב בעל שלש נמי מיבעי ליה לספירה! -- the three-sighting zav also needs the pouch, for counting

answered_by.gloss_en: לא נצרכא אלא לבו ביום -- it was needed only for that same day

objections.gloss_en: והא מיבעי ליה כדי שלא יטנפו כליו! -- he needs the pouch so his clothes are not soiled (R' Zeira's defence, p_atzulei_tinnuf_lo_chashiv, is refuted at 12a.1-2, and the sugya turns with אלא)
מי דמי? התם לא קא בעי להו להני משקין כלל, הכא קא בעי ליה להאי כיס לקבולי ביה זיבה; הא לא דמיא אלא לסיפא -- ושבתוכה הרי זה בכי יותן
